SENIOR CITIZENS COMMISSION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING

  SAi
  N

  1
  Thursday, September 7, 2023 at 6: 00 P. M.
  DIA201 E. Bonita Avenue
  1960
  Senior Center/ Community Center

1.  Call to Order and Flag Salute

Senior Citizens Commission meeting was called to order by the Director of Parks and
Recreation, Scott Wasserman at 6: 00 p. m.

2.  Roll Call

Present:  Wally Nikowitz
  Nancy Brewster
  Bill Beebe
  Sandra Martinez
  Rita Karasik- McGee

Also Present: Chris Constantin, City Manager
  Scott Wasserman,  Director, Parks & Recreation
  Emmett Badar, Mayor
  Eric Nakano,  Council  Member
  John Ebiner, Council  Member
  Dominique  Borba, Recreation  Supervisor
  Orlando Soto, Recreation Coordinator
  Alexis Luna, Departmental  Assistant

Absent:

3.  Swearing in of New Commissioners

Departmental  Assistant,  Alexis Luna,  read and conducted  the Oath of Office to each
commissioner.

4.  Commissioner  Orientation

Scott Wasserman, Director of Parks and recreation, presented the Parks and
Recreation Department Overview and reviewed the orientation sheet. He also went over
the attendance policy for commissioners.

Commissioner  Nikowitz suggested  that staff roles should be introduced  for the next

meeting since there are new commissioners and staff.
 Senior Citizens  Commission  Minutes
September  7, 2023  Page 2

City Manager, Chris Constantin reviewed the training requirements for all
Commissioners. He went over the structure of the city and the roles of each
commission. He welcomed everyone and thanked them for their service.

5.  Selection of Chair and Vice Chair

Mr. Wasserman stated that the staff liaison would be the main point of contact and
would create agenda before each meeting.

Mr. Constantin went over the Rosenburg Rules and opened the floor for nominations.

Mr. Beebe nominated Mr. Wally Nikowitz for Chairperson. All were in favor.

Mr. Wally Nikowitz nominated Ms. Nancy Brewster for Vice Chair. All were in favor.

Mr. Nikowitz and Ms. Brewster accept, motion carries.

6.  Adjournment

The meeting was adjourned by Vice Chairperson, Nancy Brewster at 6: 57 p. m. and
second by Chairperson, Wally Nikowitz. The next scheduled Commission meeting
will be on November 2, 2023 at 6: 00 P. M.

Departmental Assistant
